name: kognite
stderr:
Usage: kognite [options] [command]

Kognite CLI — long-term memory for AI agents

Options:
  -v, --version    Show version number
  -h, --help       display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]  Authenticate with Kognite via OAuth device flow or PAT
  mcp              Start the MCP stdio→HTTP proxy (for Claude Desktop, Cursor,
                   etc.)
  sync [options]   Sync MCP server configs to local client config files
  config           View or edit local configuration
  status           Show connection status, scope info, and usage stats
  skill            Manage skills (Agent Skills SKILL.md import/export)
  rules            Import agent rules files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Cursor,
                   Copilot, Windsurf) as context blocks
  blocks           Manage pinned context blocks (always-on team/project context)
  hook [event]     Claude Code hook handler: session-start | pre-compact | stop
                   | session-end (reads hook JSON on stdin)
  help [command]   display help for command

Examples:
  $ kognite login                        Authenticate via OAuth device flow
  $ kognite login --token <api-key>      Authenticate with an API key
  $ kognite mcp                          Start the MCP stdio proxy
  $ kognite skill export my-skill -o .claude/skills
  $ kognite skill import .claude/skills  Import every SKILL.md below a folder
  $ kognite rules import --dry-run       Preview AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/Cursor rules as blocks
  $ kognite blocks list                  List pinned context blocks
  $ kognite status                       Show connection and usage status

Documentation: https://kognite.dev/docs
